attr.title: Killer Instinct (Arcade) — R36S ARM64
attr.desc: Native ARM64 R36S KI port with dual executable ABI (dArkOSRE >=2.38/ArkOS4Clone >=2.28), selection by firmware glibc.
attr.inst: Supply your own lawful kinst.zip (KI1 L1.5D) and kinst.chd in killerinstinct/gamedata; dual ABI binaries selected automatically.
